findings.description: ProjectCard uses preventDefault() on GitHub and Live Demo anchor tags, preventing their href attributes from working. Users see the buttons but clicking does nothing.

After uploading, the SupabaseUploader component uses incorrect array slice logic (slice(-previewUrls.length + selectedFiles.length)) that leaves blob URLs in memory instead of clearing them, causing resource leaks on form reuse.
The backend accepts any non-empty URL string without verifying the image exists or is accessible. Invalid URLs will be stored and fail silently on the frontend.

findings.issue: Admin cannot remove images during edit
findings.description: The edit form only allows adding more images to existing projects; users cannot remove images, requiring backend or database fixes for corrections.
